Our Company

S. Phaneuf & Associates was established with a vision to provide residents and businesses in Massachusetts and Southern New Hampshire with reliable, professional asphalt paving, excavation, masonry and hardscaping. As an expert paving company, we specialize in creating stunning outdoor spaces that are both functional and aesthetically pleasing. Whether you're looking to install a new paved driveway, build a beautiful outdoor patio, or improve the accessibility of your property with asphalt paving, our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional results that will enhance the look and feel of your entire outdoor space. With a passion for excellence and a commitment to integrity, Steve Phaneuf set out to build a company that would exceed expectations in every project undertaken.

Our mission is simple: to transform your vision into reality. Whether you're looking to enhance your property with stunning masonry work or improve its functionality with expert paving services, we're here to deliver outstanding results that stand the test of time.

We are separated from other companies in New England by our high quality service and affordable costs. Your project doesn't have to come with a premium price-tag. In fact, you can get the professional results you deserve without investing massive amounts of income. Our local crew has the materials, skills, and experience to deliver a powerful experience that you'll be happy with. To learn more about the asphalt paving, excavation, masonry, and hardscaping services we offer in Concord and the surrounding areas, please visit our service areas page.

What We Offer

S. Phaneuf & Associates is a full-service hardscape and paving company offering a wide range of services for both residential and commercial clients. We specialize in asphalt paving for driveways, parking lots, and roads, as well as stunning masonry construction and hardscaping solutions. Our services also include landscape construction, excavation and site development, and snow and ice management. Whether you're looking to enhance your outdoor space with a new patio, walkway, or asphalt driveway, or need comprehensive site development, we have the experience and expertise to ensure your project is completed on time and to the highest standards. Our professional team provides clients with a seamless experience, handling all aspects of the job, no matter its size or scope, ensuring quality results every time.

Our Service Areas

At S. Phaneuf & Associates, we are proud to serve a wide range of communities across Massachusetts, offering high-quality services to both residential and commercial clients. Whether you're a homeowner looking for hardscaping or a business in need of asphalt paving, we have you covered. Explore the regions and towns where we provide top-notch services:

We specialize in serving the following regions:

  • Greater Boston Area: From the heart of Boston to surrounding neighborhoods, we deliver professional services to both urban and suburban areas.
  • North Shore Massachusetts: Including communities along the coast, we serve towns like Salem, Beverly, and Gloucester.
  • South Shore Massachusetts: Providing expert services to towns such as Quincy, Weymouth, and Plymouth.
  • Western Massachusetts: Offering comprehensive services to residents and businesses in Springfield, Northampton, and the Berkshires.
  • Central Massachusetts: Our team serves the towns of Worcester, Fitchburg, and surrounding areas.
  • Additional Communities: We proudly extend our services to smaller towns and rural areas across the state, providing tailored solutions wherever needed.

If you're looking for expert services in your area, we invite you to explore our service area page for more details.
